opportunities.name: Movie night invite with ratings
opportunities.description: Look up a movie on IMDb and Rotten Tomatoes, then draft an email inviting a friend to movie night on a given day, including the director, runtime, IMDb rating and Tomatometer score.
steps: On IMDb, search for {movie_title} and open the matching title page
Note the director, runtime and IMDb rating
On Rotten Tomatoes, search for {movie_title} and open the matching movie page
In mail, compose a new message to {recipient_email}
Set the body to 'Hi {recipient_name}, {day} we watch {movie_title} ({director}, {runtime}): IMDb {imdb_rating}, Tomatometer {tomatometer}.'
Send the draft (in the recording it was discarded instead)

instances.values: movie=The Grand Budapest Hotel (IMDb and RT lookups only; interleaved with npm activity; recording ends before the email)

opportunities.name: npm package health summary note
opportunities.description: Look up an npm package and its GitHub repo, then save a note with the package's latest version, weekly downloads, license, stars, open issues and last release date.
steps: On npmjs, search for {package_name} and open the package page
Note the version, weekly downloads and license
Note the stars and open issues count
Open Releases and note the date of the latest release
In notes, create a new note: '{package}: v{version}, {weekly_downloads}/week, {license}, {stars} stars, {open_issues} open issues, last release {date}'

instances.values: package=express (only reached the npm page; incomplete)

opportunities.name: Recipe pick with origin note
opportunities.description: Search Allrecipes for a dish, open a top-rated recipe, look up the dish's origin on Wikipedia, then save a note with the servings, recipe name, rating, total time, first ingredients and origin.
steps: On Allrecipes, search for {dish} and open a highly rated recipe
Note the recipe name, star rating, total time and first few ingredients
On Wikipedia, search for {dish} and note its origin
In notes, create a new note: '{dish} for {servings}: {recipe_name} ({rating} stars, {time}), needs {ingredients}. Origin: {origin}'
